riskSignals.rationale: Official HTML menu, official nutritional image surface, Bethesda Toast menu, and generic Toast menu were found.
Nutritional page is image-based and did not expose machine-readable allergen data.
Current Bethesda Toast includes products absent from the frozen baseline, while some frozen entries are headings or stale/renamed presentations.
No complete restaurant-issued allergen matrix or cross-contact statement was found.

findings.summary: The current catalog spans official menu products, Bethesda Toast products, and generic Toast products; duplicate presentations require consolidation and several frozen rows are headings or stale variants.

The official nutritional page exposes images without accessible allergen arrays or cross-contact language. Menu descriptions support narrow positive ingredient evidence but cannot establish absence or complete arrays.

summary: Bethesda identity verified and current official/linked menu surfaces found. The frozen baseline is not a one-to-one catalog: category headings are artifacts, several products are missing or renamed across surfaces, and the ordering menu includes extra items. No complete allergen or cross-contact disclosure was accessible; unavailable/accurately_unavailable is required for incomplete allergen claims.
